notes: The dual שְׁבֻעַיִם takes two weeks in one unit headed on weeks, since the lexeme sits on the noun and the English two realizes the dual of that same morpheme (rules 24, 31).
The italic her before purifying is added here as at v.4, the Hebrew טָהֳרָה carrying no suffix (rule 18's closing sentence; rule 7).

עַל is aligned to the in the ASV actually wrote (rule 11), and the numeral phrase again gives the single and to the one waw standing between threescore and six, with days on the last absolute (rules 42, 22).
The marginal 'separation' for נִדָּה is a lexical alternative only (rule 38).
